name: Bytes Import/Export Lite
author: Bytes Technolab

sections.description:
When this plugin is activated, your WP admin can export and import data. The export/Import page will appear in your WordPress backend admin menu. Check the settings page to export selected post fields (data) and selected post status.

Features

Set different post fields to export specific data.

The administrator can set the post status.

Export posts by selecting the author’s name and date.

Select or import the author for the post.

See a compiled list of all imported posts with metadata and authors.

If the authors are not there, it will also create the users in WordPress admin.

Libraries Used

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries:

  1. Remodal

    • Description: A responsive, lightweight, and easily configurable modal plugin.
    • Website: Remodal by VodkaBears
    • License: MIT License

  2. Bootstrap

    • Description: The world’s most popular framework for building responsive, mobile-first websites.
    • Website: Bootstrap
    • License: MIT License
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements
– WordPress 5.6 or greater
– PHP version 7.4 or greater
– MySQL version 5.0 or greater
– Recommended PHP Configuration Limits
– Max_execution_time 1000
– Memory_limit 512M
– Upload_max_filesize 64M
– Post_max_size 16M

Installation
– Upload ‘bytes-import-export-lite’ to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory.
– Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
– View the admin menu, then click ‘BT Lite’ to start importing/exporting data.
sections.faq:
Do we require coding to use the “Bytes Import/Export Lite” plugin?

This plugin does not require coding. To activate and use it, you simply have to follow the installation steps given on this page.

Does this plugin require any other plugin?

Of course not. This plugin does not require any other plugin to be used on the WordPress platform.

How can I export custom posts in this plugin?

Once the plugin is installed and activated, it becomes effortless. You can export custom posts by visiting the export page in the BT Lite menu and exporting using the author name and date filter.

How can I import custom posts in this plugin?

You can import custom posts by visiting the import page in the BT Lite menu page. You only have to import custom posts by assigning existing authors or importing new authors for the posts.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • New: redesigned all admin screens (Export, Import, Settings, About) with a cleaner card-based layout, a branded header, and tab navigation between screens.
  • New: the import screen now shows a progress bar while posts are imported in the background.
  • Fix: the author dropdown on the Export screen could render empty instead of listing available authors, on sites with posts that have no valid author (for example, content brought in by another import tool).
  • Fix: author mapping was lost after the first import batch, causing imported posts beyond the first 10 to be attributed to the current user instead of the mapped/created author.
  • Fix: exporting with the Post Status setting left at “All” returned zero posts.
  • Security: import file uploads are now validated as JSON instead of disabling WordPress’s file-type checks.
  • Security: images referenced in imported files are now fetched through WordPress’s safe HTTP API instead of a raw file read, blocking unsafe URL schemes and local/internal addresses.
  • Fix: importing an invalid, empty, or corrupted file no longer triggers a fatal error; a clear error message is shown instead.
  • Fix: the temporary uploaded import file is now actually cleaned up after one hour as intended.
  • Fix: the plugin deactivation-feedback payload no longer hardcodes version 1.0.0.
  • Removed an unconditionally-loaded, empty front-end script (no functional impact, minor performance improvement).
  • Removed unnecessary unauthenticated AJAX endpoints for admin-only actions.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1 and PHP 8.3.

1.0.0

  • First release.
